default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-1418.title: Return autocorrelation regime
E-1418.hypothesis: When lag-1 return autocorrelation over a window is clearly negative, bar moves are being absorbed by liquidity providers: fade the bar; when clearly positive, orders are being worked in slices: follow it.

E-1419.title: Regression-channel edge fade
E-1419.hypothesis: Price that stretches more than k residual deviations from the rolling least-squares line is overextended relative to its own trend; fade back.

E-1420.title: Trend-slope t-statistic follow
E-1420.hypothesis: A statistically significant rolling slope (high t-stat) means directional flow is persistent rather than noise; follow when it first crosses.

E-1421.title: EMA ribbon alignment onset
E-1421.hypothesis: When fast, medium and slow EMAs line up in order with price on the fast side, participants at all horizons are on the same side; follow the first alignment.

E-1422.title: Converging-triangle break
E-1422.hypothesis: Lower highs and higher lows with a shrinking range compress resting orders on both sides; a close outside the recent half-range releases them.

E-1423.title: ATR-band re-entry fade
E-1423.hypothesis: A close outside an EMA +/- k*average-range band followed by a close back inside marks an exhausted push; fade toward the mean.

E-1424.title: VWAP sigma-band re-entry fade
E-1424.hypothesis: Distance from VWAP measured in the session's own deviation of that distance: after a close beyond k sigma, the first close back inside is a sign the stretch is over; fade toward VWAP.

E-1425.title: Shock bar confirmed retrace fade
E-1425.hypothesis: A bar with an extreme return z-score often comes from a single aggressive order; when the next bar closes back through the shock bar's midpoint the shock is being reversed, so fade it.

E-1426.title: Price-volume correlation sign follow
E-1426.hypothesis: If volume systematically rises on up bars (positive return-volume correlation) buyers are the aggressive side; if on down bars, sellers are. Follow the side on which volume concentrates.

E-1427.title: Run exhaustion reclaim
E-1427.hypothesis: After a run of consecutive down (up) closes, a close above the previous bar's high (below its low) shows the run's sellers (buyers) have stopped; trade the reclaim.
